content:
nate: Quick heads-up  deploy-preview thumbnails are 403ing (CDN auth). 3 PRs blocked because diagrams show as broken images. Can we triage reviewers so the rest can be merged?
arjun: which PRs are hit?
nate: #3022 (architecture diagram in migration guide), #3025 (js sdk snippet + diagram), #3030 (go sdk examples with inline pngs).
lina: I can take #3025 (js snippet). I'll run the snippet and update import path if needed.
maya: I'll grab #3030 (go examples). I have a quick local env to test the examples.
arjun: I'll handle #3022 but need the preview URL and a note about the diagram source. If CDN is the culprit we might have to replace with inline SVGs.
doc-ops-bot: deploy-preview links: https://deploy-preview-3022--docs.redwood.example/, https://deploy-preview-3025--docs.redwood.example/, https://deploy-preview-3030--docs.redwood.example/ ; image-check: 3 failures (CDN auth 403).
release-coordinator: FYI we need those merged before Friday's patch cut. If CDN fix is delayed, consider swapping diagrams for minimal ASCII fallbacks so text content can land.
nate: good call. Quick reviewer assignment: Lina -> #3025, Maya -> #3030, Arjun -> #3022. Added label `reviewer:docs-surge` and `docs:urgent` to all three.
lina: testing #3025 now. small nit: the snippet uses callback-style promise chain; should switch to async/await example per new guide. I'll push a tiny rewrite.
maya: ran go examples; 2 of 3 commands work but one flags `--region` mismatch in examples. Pushing fix.
arjun: checked #3022 preview. Diagram PNG 403. I replaced the image with an inline SVG placeholder and left a comment asking author to re-export. Also validated table of kv-cache TTLs; looks consistent.
nate: nice. Quick manual reviewer checklist I'm pasting to the PRs:
```
- open deploy-preview link and confirm visuals render or placeholder is acceptable
- run snippet/example in local env (node 18 / go1.20)
- confirm code fences have language tags and match test fixtures
- sanity-check numeric table cells (units and rounding)
- if linkcheck or image-check flakes, comment `image-check:manual-verified`
```
release-coordinator: If someone manually verifies due to CDN flakiness, add a short PR comment with steps taken and who signed off (so QA can audit).
lina: pushed async/await rewrite for #3025 and left an inline note about the returned promise being awaited.
maya: fixed region flag and minor wording in #3030. left one non-blocking nit about a trailing space in a code fence.
arjun: after swapping to inline SVG for #3022, I asked the author to re-upload the high-res export to the CDN. marked PR `needs-image` until that lands.
nate: since this is a surge day, can we temporarily add a second reviewer for any migration or SDK snippet PRs? Rotation is thin today.
release-coordinator: I'm updating the rotation sheet: add one extra backup reviewer for the next 48h and notify doc-rotation-leads.
doc-ops-bot: label `reviewer:docs-surge` applied to #3022 #3025 #3030. image-check rerun scheduled in 30m.
arjun: merged #3022 (inline placeholder) after author approved re-upload plan.
nate: great. #3025 and #3030 pending final thumbs. Lina/Maya can you mark `image-check:manual-verified` if the diagrams are acceptable placeholders?
lina: marked `image-check:manual-verified` on #3025 and left steps: (ran snippet node18, checked console output).
maya: marked `image-check:manual-verified` on #3030. Also added a short migration note in the go examples about region flag changes.
release-coordinator: excellent. I'll keep the extra reviewer slot in rotation through end of week. Also adding a short blurb to docs-contrib about when to fallback to ASCII/inline SVGs when previews are broken.
nate: thanks everyone. tagging follow-up: update the diagram upload docs so authors know how to refresh CDN tokens.
doc-ops-bot: thread closed automatically after 90 minutes of inactivity.
